verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official, documented `sentry-cli` (confirmed by probe). Its docs cover installation, token login, releases, debug files, source maps, code mappings, crons, sending events, streaming logs and snapshot uploads. Sentry's docs also explicitly position the CLI, alongside the MCP server, for use inside agent conversations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in agent workflows, and evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output.
